meta.description: MixSwitch smart switch: Red Dot award-winning minimalist design in three colors, works without a neutral wire, exclusive MixCtrl™ technology to set what each key does, a remote switch you can place anywhere, RelayPro-Tech™ relay protection and Zigbee 3.0.
meta.spec.description: MixSwitch specifications: the battery remote panel, the one-, two- and three-gang smart switches and the five-hole socket, with models, sizes, power, load, wireless protocol and operating conditions.
banner.banner_title:
Tech meets aesthetics
Art for your walls
banner.subtitle: Works without a neutral wire, no rewiring: fitted in 2 minutes
sec1.sec12:
Three refined colors
Art for everyday life
sec1.sec14:
Exclusive MixCtrl™
Set what each key does
sec2.title:
Beauty in simplicity
For exceptional taste
sec2.desc:
Its clean, simple form fits into many design styles.
MixSwitch is pared back to the essentials,
without losing any of its elegant, distinctive artistry.
sec2.quote: “The modular design concept of the smart MixSwitch is well-executed and has resulted in a stylish exterior that can be customised.”
sec3.title: Three refined colors, technology as art
sec3.desc:
Elegant, understated ivory white, deep and calm space gray, simple and stately champagne gold:
they match many home styles and lift the look of the whole home.
sec4.title:
Exclusive MixCtrl™ technology
Set what each key does
sec4.desc:
ORVIBO's own MixCtrl™ technology breaks the one-key, one-device limit of
ordinary switches. Combine functions to suit your habits and control several
smart devices at once, for rich, efficient scenes and a better smart home.
sec5_1.title: Set it your way: smart living at a touch
sec5_1.desc:
Paired with other smart devices, it lets you set up richer, more useful scene controls around your habits. For the first time, one switch
does two jobs, basic lighting and scene panel, opening up endless, wire-free possibilities for smart living.
sec6_1.title: Anytime, anywhere: the ease of AI
sec6.title:
Heading out?
Just one press
sec6.desc: One press turns off every light at home.
sec6.title2:
No need to
get out of bed
sec6.desc2: Turn off every light by voice, with AI.
sec6.title3:
Away from home?
Use your phone
sec6.desc3:
Check in the ORVIBO app whether
you left a light on.
sec7_1.title: A switch you can move: smart control anywhere
sec7_1.desc:
A small, refined smart remote switch with six customizable keys that freely combine single devices and scenes. No wiring, place it anywhere
and enjoy efficient, comfortable smart living.
sec7.after: * The remote panel runs on a standard CR2032 coin battery that lasts over a year (at normal temperature and humidity).
sec8.title: Precise to 0.1 mm, made for perfectionists
sec8.desc:
The Millimeter Frame is ORVIBO's mounting accessory for pairing MixSwitch with MixPad Mini. Made to 0.1 mm, it leaves no gap even for a sheet
of paper, so the joints stay even and neat: true wall art, as it was designed.
sec9.title: Combine freely, mix and match
sec10.title: Hard-core tech that pushes lifespan further
sec10.desc:
Patented RelayPro-Tech™ technology passes 2000 V lightning surge tests to protect the relay. Rated for over 60,000 switchings and 15+ years of use,
it is a home product built to industrial standards.
sec10.after:
* Data from ORVIBO lab tests at normal temperature and humidity, assuming 10 switchings a day.
Actual results may vary slightly with the environment.
sec11.title:
Zigbee 3.0 inside
Rock-solid wireless, even in large homes
sec11.desc:
Zigbee 3.0 makes transmission faster and more stable, with almost zero latency. It keeps working even when the internet is down
and links many devices efficiently.
